name: Krate Mono
classification_notes: A fixed-width typeface from a London-based MATD graduate. The name and mono designation point to a structured, contemporary monospaced design in the current tradition of design-conscious fixed-width faces intended for both display and technical use.
summary: A fixed-width typeface from Fred Wiltshire, MATD Reading graduate and ADC Young Guns 23 winner.
description: Krate Mono is a monospaced typeface released under Fred Wiltshire's FredsFonts label, following his Masters in Type Design at the University of Reading. Fixed-width by construction, the face carries the rigour of a formally trained designer into a format that often skews utilitarian. The family spans multiple weights, making it suited to both display headlines and code or technical contexts.
foundry_blurb: FredsFonts is run by Fred Wiltshire, a British/French type designer based in London who completed the MATD programme at the University of Reading in 2020/2021. He also contributes type development work to other foundries alongside releasing his own independent typefaces.
